test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Each vowel in the word GRADIENT is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter preceding it in the English alphabetical order. Which of the following letters will appear twice in the group of letters thus formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0843b7217712ba1e93f65f88f65caeb432c041c8006439e9525ea8feb3cc271f.png] 

1) Replace all the vowels to the following letter of them in the English alphabet. So we increased by **+1 **in a vowel.
2) Every consonant is also replaced to the preceding letter. So we decreased by **-1 **in a consonant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86930b28e739973d9a94268a0ad07497c4371a4076ad102ff79a9ee7c0fc8ad9.png] 
We can see in the new word **FQBCJFMS**, the **F** letter will appear twice in the group of letters thus formed.
Hence, the correct answer is "F".
